name: Changes made to TFC

pages.text: GT5R makes a few changes to recipes and ores in regular TFC. This chapter exists to help direct you towards areas where this is very different.
Some TFC $(l:gt5r:gt5r/ores)Ore Veins$() have had some gt ores injected into them, and in addition some new gt veins have been added.
pages.title: Ores

pages.text: By default Bismuth Bronze, Black Bronze, Sterling Silver, and Rose Gold alloy recipes have had their percentage variance decreased. Look at the recipes in jei/emi/rei to see what has changed.
pages.title: Alloys
